name: Darjeeling Industries Ltd
tagline: SEBI ENFORCEMENT ACTION - EXCLUDED, active fraud/manipulation allegations
summary: Source sheet flagged '~2.7X (also discussed re: SEBI order / manipulation comments)' - this research confirms and substantially escalates that flag: this is not community speculation but a confirmed, active SEBI ex-parte interim order.
fundamentals_table: Ex-parte interim order, June 30, 2026 - MD Ashok Dilipkumar Jain + 9 others BARRED from trading
Circular funding of preferential allotment, misuse of proceeds, suspected price manipulation
fundamentals_narrative: Do not evaluate on fundamentals - SEBI's order alleges the company's registered offices (Mumbai and Rajkot) could not be located, raising doubts about whether commercial operations are genuine, and that revenue/profit increases announced right after the new MD's Oct 2024 appointment coincide with the alleged manipulation scheme. WhatsApp evidence allegedly ties the MD to a market operator, discussing shareholder lists and market operations.
